justification: Removes 'ku-ring-gai' from NEAREST_FALLBACK_LGAS in frontend-nextjs/lib/precinct-service.ts. Ku-ring-gai has 10 site-specific precinct boundaries covering 0.29 km2 of an ~85 km2 LGA (verified live against dcp_precinct_boundaries 2026-07-29), so the 500m nearest-boundary snap serves controls for an area the property is not in. Same rationale as Waverley's exclusion in #835; Inner West (tiling precincts) keeps the fallback.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_precinct_boundaries: 10 rows LOWER(lga) LIKE 'ku%', SUM(area_sqm)=0.2904 km2. The gate was introduced in #835 with the set ['inner west', 'ku-ring-gai'].
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If Ku-ring-gai precincts actually tiled the LGA, removing the snap would drop legitimate edge-case matches; the 0.29 km2 coverage disproves tiling.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: One-line set membership change plus comment update; containment (ST_Contains) matching for Ku-ring-gai is unchanged.

functions: getPrecinctUsingPostGIS: for lga='Ku-ring-gai', a containment miss now returns null instead of calling findNearestPrecinct.

break_it.scenario: An address genuinely inside a Ku-ring-gai precinct polygon but geocoded a few metres outside it (kerbline geocode) previously snapped to the right precinct; now it returns no precinct.
break_it.what_happens: Under-inclusion for that edge case: the precinct layer is excluded and the existing precinct_warning banner fires, matching the Waverley behaviour.
break_it.how: Honest miss preferred over the common wrong-area serve: with 0.34% area coverage, nearly every 500m-snap match was for a property NOT in the precinct. Containment matching is untouched.
break_it.repro: Geocode an address on the boundary of 14I Killara Golf Club a few metres outside the polygon; before: snapped match, after: no precinct + warning.

break_it.scenario: LGA string arrives as 'Ku-Ring-Gai' with different casing.
break_it.what_happens: Gate lowercases and trims before the set lookup; casing cannot re-enable the fallback.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - a Ku-ring-gai address outside the 10 polygons shows no precinct rules plus the precinct_warning banner on verify.plotdetect.com.au.
